name: Resonant Masjid
summary: Three concentric sound arcs become the structural ribs of an open mosque dome, grounded by a prayer hall and one minaret.
why: All three roof arcs and the doorway share x=54. Every arc terminates exactly on the hall at y=53, so each rib is physically joined through the foundation. The bands are four units thick with three units between them. The attached minaret shares foundation y=74 with the hall; its cap, collar, and shaft overlap rather than float.
risk: The roof is deliberately symbolic and can suggest a broadcast signal on its own. The complete mark retains a large arched doorway and substantial minaret to anchor the mosque reading.
sub1: Sound arcs form an open mosque roof
sub2: Three nested ribs on one foundation
theme: Sound shaped as a mosque roof
reasonToChoose: You want the call to prayer built into the mosque itself.
